name: product-scope
description: Define the next VenturaRobo MVP slice for simulated path planning perception or ROS 2 integration with measurable safety criteria. Use when deciding what the incubation repository should implement next. Do not use when controlling physical hardware or claiming real-world safety readiness.
---

# Product scope

- Start from `README.md` planned capabilities safety notes and Beta criteria.
- Choose one simulation scenario and one measurable robotics behavior.
- Define map sensor assumptions success metric and failure boundary.
- Keep physical actuation out of the MVP until simulation evidence and safety controls exist.
- State required emergency-stop supervision and workspace constraints for any later hardware phase.
- Require reproducible simulation tests and documented limitations before completion.
